commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "ef1a903a74dfd3df588f7598fa378126c55865c6"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
cd frontend
VITE_API_BASE_URL= npm run build
test -s dist/index.html
echo RELEASE_INDEX_SHA256
shasum -a 256 dist/index.html
echo RELEASE_ASSETS
grep -oE '/assets/[^"]+\\.(js|css)' dist/index.html | head -n 15
